# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 8 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 8
AnAO 8 (also written as AO8 or Administrative Officer Level 8) earns **$154,786–$163,552** gross — roughly $111,000–$117,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$173,000–$183,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 8 salary?
An Administrative AO 8 (also written as AO8 or Administrative Officer Level 8) earns $154,786 to $163,552 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
